title: kk7.1: tower-http dep + CorsConfig in config.rs
description:
What: Add tower-http (cors feature) to crates/mail/Cargo.toml and add CorsConfig struct to config.rs.

Algorithm:
1. In crates/mail/Cargo.toml, add: tower-http = { version = "0.6", features = ["cors"] }
2. In crates/mail/src/config.rs, add a CorsConfig struct:
   pub struct CorsConfig {
     pub enabled: bool,          // default false
     pub allowed_origins: Vec<String>,  // e.g. ["*"] or ["https://mail.example.com"]
   }
   with #[serde(default)] and Default impl (enabled=false, allowed_origins=vec![])
3. Add #[serde(default)] pub cors: CorsConfig to the top-level Config struct.

Defensive programming:
- CorsConfig::default() must have enabled=false (secure default)
- Vec<String> origins must be validated at use-time (not here)
- No unwrap() in Default impl

Tests: cargo check --package usenet-ipfs-mail must succeed.
Acceptance: cargo check clean; CorsConfig appears in Config struct with enabled=false default.
